# Isaiah Chapter 66 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 24 verses]*

*Heaven is throne, earth footstool; humble and contrite; Zion's sudden birth; new moon to new moon; all flesh worships*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 66 (Final Judgment and Glory) addresses heaven is throne, earth footstool; humble and contrite; zion's sudden birth; new moon to new moon; all flesh worships. The key verse — "As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Third Isaiah (chs. 56-66), focused on the restored community and eschatological hope.
